text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
A crushing defeat... I never imagined it 
would turn out like this...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Leading up to today, I haven't wasted a 
single second of training.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I'm feeling good, too. I've also come up 
with solid strategies against my rivals.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
choice_data_list: I don't think your method is wrong.
It just means a lack of ability.
It just means a lack of ability.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
choice_data_list: I don't think your method is wrong.
It just means a lack of ability.
It just means a lack of ability.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
It's not wrong... It's true that in a 
race, factors outside of oneself also 
influence the outcome...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
There is a saying: "victory is a matter of 
luck." There are times when even earnest 
effort falls short.
choice_data_list: Practice was perfect. We'll win next time.
Practice was perfect. We'll win next time.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you very much. I feel a little 
better now.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I promise you, neither the bitter 
experience of today's defeat nor all the 
training we've done will go to waste.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...You are right. This is the extent of my 
current ability...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Even if I agonize over it, I 
suppose that's the only way to win.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Let's hold a review session right when we 
get back. Next time, I definitely won't 
lose...!
